title: Lori Loughlin Files for Divorce from Mossimo Giannulli
summary: Actress Lori Loughlin has filed for divorce from her husband, Mossimo Giannulli, after nearly 29 years of marriage. The filing was made after almost three decades together.
summary_points: Lori Loughlin filed for divorce from Mossimo Giannulli.
The couple was married for nearly 29 years.
The divorce filing occurred after almost three decades of marriage.
